maddeler.e:
أختطف (form VIII)
# أَخْتَطِفُ (ʔaḵtaṭifu) /ʔax.ta.tˤi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# أُخْتَطَفُ (ʔuḵtaṭafu) /ʔux.ta.tˤa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# أَخْتَطِفَ (ʔaḵtaṭifa) /ʔax.ta.tˤi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# أُخْتَطَفَ (ʔuḵtaṭafa) /ʔux.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
